sections.notes: Goal, roadmap, and release criteria have been reviewed and refreshed for alpha/pre-v0 positioning.

Public app/task expansion, private holdout aggregate counts, the combined vulnerable/control mix, the first project-management multi-step workflow wave, and the generated public task-quality matrix have review coverage. This section is reviewed; current model/tool-agent reruns remain tracked by the baseline credibility gate.

Scorer, runner, request-log correlation, live tool-agent execution proof on both public and private holdouts, and tool-agent plan/probe artifact summary telemetry have complete review coverage. This section is v0-ready.

Review coverage for registry, leaderboard validators, current 46-task public model summaries, the repeated current 46-task public tool-agent baseline, chart readability, and current-public benchmark fingerprint comparability is complete. This does not mean the baseline gate is complete: two repeated current 46-task public no-tools model families and one repeated current public tool-agent family now exist; two more current repeated model/agent families are still required before this evidence can support a v0 claim.

Holdout workflow, anti-gaming checks, redacted private-pack evidence, protected execution, private live tool-agent evidence, route/decoy variant counts, and final anti-gaming release review now have evidence-backed coverage. Rotating multi-pack private holdouts and fully hosted/containerized leaderboard execution remain post-v0 hardening items.

CI, privacy scan, release evidence, baseline gates, local private-holdout gates, stale-doc cleanup, and final release-readiness review now have evidence-backed coverage. This marks a v0 release-candidate state, not a tagged release or hosted public leaderboard.
